Protocol normalization and twin path
OPC UA + Modbus signals are normalized to twin semantic graph states.
Predictive scoring triggers governed maintenance tickets rather than direct unsafe writes.
latency p95: OPC UA 268ms · Modbus bridge 329ms · safety gate 46ms
Governance and outcomes
safety write unauthorized block: 99.0%

Safety-domain hard rule
Agents can recommend, but cannot directly issue unsafe control writes to critical PLC domains.
All high-impact actions pass deterministic policy gate and owner approval path.
